title: Force Field Lab
objectives: Predict the effects of a force

stages.title: The Great Standstill
stages.narration: Motion has frozen. Master force, Force Finder, and set the world moving again!

steps.text: Baron Standstill freezes all motion on Earth.
Professor Mass: 'The Momentum Core is drained!'
Newton Bot: 'Learn what a force is to recharge it.'

stages.title: Push or Pull?
stages.prompt: Decide whether each action is mainly a push or a pull.

tasks.label: Closing a door away from you
tasks.explain: Pushing the door away is a push force.

tasks.label: Opening a drawer toward you
tasks.explain: Pulling the drawer toward you is a pull force.

tasks.label: A magnet drawing a pin closer
tasks.explain: The magnet pulls the pin toward it.

tasks.label: Moving a shopping trolley ahead
tasks.explain: You push the trolley forward, away from you.

stages.title: What Can a Force Do?
stages.prompt: Tap every result that a force CAN cause.

feedback.correct: Yes! A force can do this.
feedback.incorrect: A force does not change an object's colour.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Restart the Motion
stages.prompt: Score 80% to break the Standstill and win the first Momentum shard!

questions.explain: A force is simply a push or a pull.

questions.q: Two teams pull a rope equally. The rope…
questions.explain: Equal opposite forces are balanced and cancel out.

questions.q: Catching a moving ball is a force that…
questions.explain: The force stops the moving ball.
Same-direction forces add to a bigger net force.

questions.q: To describe a force fully you need…
questions.explain: A force has both magnitude and direction.

stages.title: Momentum Shard 1 Charged!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Force Finder badge
The first gears begin to turn again!
